title: workspace-kinds.json
description: Member kinds a plugin supplies (#2524 D3, #2535, ws-031). A package publishes this file as data at its ./workspace-kinds subpath. chant reads it with the file system and never imports the package, so reading kinds never loads a lexicon.

$schema.description: An editor hint. chant ignores it.

$comment.description: A note for people. chant ignores it.

name.description: The kind's name, as a member's kind field names it. chant, workspace, other and examples are built in and can't be supplied.

description.description: One line saying what the member's directory holds, for listings and error messages.

precedence.description: When the probes of several kinds claim one directory, the highest precedence decides. Two claiming kinds with the same highest precedence are a tie, and a tie fails. The built-in chant kind has 500 and workspace has 1000.

probe.description: What the probe checks in a member's directory. It runs no code. It passes when any of its clauses does, and it needs at least one.

anyFile.description: The directory passes when a file matching one of these names sits directly in it. A * in a name matches any run of characters, so *.tf matches every Terraform file.

anyBlock.description: The directory passes when a file directly in it, whose name matches one of in, has a line opening an unlabelled block named in blocks: leading space, the name, optional space, then {. No file is parsed.

fileName.description: A file name, with no directory part. A * matches any run of characters.
